summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a UK-style notification of transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities, the US-equivalent Form 4 insider report. The independent Trustee of the BAT Group Employee Trust released 770 ordinary 25p shares to Pascale Meulemeester, Regional Director Asia-Pacific, Middle East and Africa, under the Restricted Share Plan on 30 September 2026 at nil cost. She sold 364 shares at 41.803879 pence-equivalent per share, roughly $15,216.61, to cover tax withholding. No board recommendation, advisor, stake change, or special-situation mechanics are implicated; the filing is routine compensation disclosure.
